events.text: Your riser-fed planter is on the build plate — setting up the pipe-through bin.

parts.name: Rod socket
parts.use: Stands a round tube up off a cell face, so a mast, a stake or a conduit riser is carried by the cluster.

parts.name: Pipe saddle, 3/4 in
parts.use: A cradle that carries a run of rigid pipe against a cell, sized by nominal pipe size and closed with a cable tie, so the pipe is held by the cluster instead ...

parts.name: Pipe saddle, 1/2 in
parts.use: A cradle that carries a run of rigid pipe against a cell, sized by nominal pipe size and closed with a cable tie, so the pipe is held by the cluster instead ...

parts.name: Pipe saddle, 1 in
parts.use: A cradle that carries a run of rigid pipe against a cell, sized by nominal pipe size and closed with a cable tie, so the pipe is held by the cluster instead ...

parts.name: Pipe socket
parts.use: Bolts a glue-in socket for 3/4 in pipe to any face that takes a bolt-on: a side flat, or the lid of a bolt cover. Solvent-weld a pipe into it with PVC primer...
